🔥 web-check | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Website analysis for open-source intelligence (OSINT), security assessment, and performance optimization.
✨ Key Features: • IP info • SSL chain analysis • DNS records • Cookie inspection • HTTP headers
📖 Summary: Web-Check is a comprehensive OSINT tool written in TypeScript that analyzes websites to provide detailed insights into their security, technology stack, and performance. It helps users understand, optimize, and secure their web presence by uncovering potential attack vectors, server configurations, and associated hostnames.
